roads.name: Paulina-East Lake Road
words: Properly twisty: 32 curves in 5.5 miles, about 6 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 4,469 to 5,914 ft, with 1,442 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.65 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Bridge Drive
words: Properly twisty: 16 curves in 2.8 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 4,190 to 4,206 ft, with 62 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 52 buildings a mile beside the road.
